preconditions: Verify every model/tokenizer/runtime hash and exact manifest field before embedding.
Accept only explicit semantic embeddings from the pinned ONNX model; reject missing, hash, random, lexical, or bag-of-words vectors.
Accept only eligible chunk IDs supplied by the effective projection; reject duplicates and unresolved overlay order.
When human approval count is zero, build may target staging only and every vector row must have human_approved=0 and activated=0.

canonical_build.input_order: ascending chunk_id by raw Unicode scalar value, secondary section_id same order; duplicate composite IDs rejected
canonical_build.embedding_text_canonicalization: CRLF/CR to LF only; preserve all remaining characters and whitespace; UTF-8
canonical_build.persistence: transactional staging SQLite; metadata and vectors committed together; production table/index untouched
canonical_build.ann_policy: No ANN library is currently available. Exact cosine is permitted only for bounded staging/evaluation; production scale requires a separately installed, pinned and audited ANN backend or an accepted exact-scan latency budget.

mandatory_verification: model revision and every model/tokenizer SHA-256 match
row count equals eligible unique chunk count
each row chunk hash equals source embedding text hash
dimension/dtype/byte length/finite values/L2 norm checks pass
each vector byte hash is recorded and reproducible exactly in the locked local runtime
read-only reopen reproduces deterministic query rankings and cosine values within 1e-6
40-anchor evaluation emits per-anchor ranks, Recall@k, nDCG@k, MRR, no-answer and must-not-route violations
critical slices show no prohibited regression against the lexical baseline
human-approved production subset is non-empty and every returned row is human_verified and publishable before any activation request
independent audit passes and explicit human authorization is recorded before atomic activation
failure_policy: Fail closed; retain prior production state and do not activate, publish, or upload.
